run_ask_sender: run ask_sender to collect attributes, strings, and meanings from a sender model on a dataset
run_information_gap_position: run information_gap_position to compute the positional information gap score for a sender model
run_information_gap_vocab: run information_gap_vocab to compute the bag-of-symbols information gap score for a sender model
run_topographic_similarity: run topographic_similarity to compute the Spearman correlation between edit distances of messages and cosine distances of inputs
run_Metrics_callback: run the Metrics callback to log positional disentanglement, bag-of-symbol disentanglement, and topographic similarity at each epoch
